subject: Trading
title: Safe-Haven Currencies
description: A micro-lesson that makes Safe-Haven Currencies usable.

hook.text: When the world panics, money floods into the US dollar, Swiss franc, and Japanese yen. Fear has a currency.

buildup.text: Safe havens are currencies from stable, liquid economies with strong legal systems and low default risk.

discovery.text: The dollar strengthens in crises because US Treasuries are the world's default safe asset. Everyone rushes in.

twist.text: The yen rises during panics—not because Japan is safe, but because carry trades unwind violently.

climax.text: Safe-haven flows create predictable patterns. Knowing them gives traders an edge when chaos strikes.

punchline.text: Panic is predictable. It always runs to safety.

quiz.question: Why does the US dollar strengthen during global crises?
options: Investors flee to US Treasuries, the world's default safe asset
